business_summary.text: Adani Energy Solutions runs transmission (about 28,000 circuit km), urban distribution in Mundra and Mumbai, India's largest smart metering platform, and a new Energy Solutions business supplying power to C&I, data centre and utility customers.

lab.quote: Currently, we have asset base of about INR83,000 crores. And we have already locked in capex of more than INR100,000 crores and that we will be delivering in another 4 to 5 years.

call_memory.quote: Currently, we have asset base of about INR83,000 crores. And we have already locked in capex of more than INR100,000 crores and that we will be delivering in another 4 to 5 years.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company has locked in capex of more than INR 100,000 crores to deliver over the next 4 to 5 years, expanding its current asset base of about INR 83,000 crores by 1.3x to 1.4x.

lab.quote: We have deployed about INR7,850 crores of capex in among all our businesses.

call_memory.quote: We have deployed about INR7,850 crores of capex in among all our businesses.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Total capex deployed across all businesses reached an all-time high of about INR 7,850 crores in the first half of the year.

lab.quote: As far as Transmission is concerned, during this quarter, we added another two projects. One is at Vizag Pendurthi and second one is Satara. And with these two projects, our order book remains at about INR87,000 crores.

call_memory.quote: As far as Transmission is concerned, during this quarter, we added another two projects. One is at Vizag Pendurthi and second one is Satara. And with these two projects, our order book remains at about INR87,000 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Transmission order book stands at about INR 87,000 crores after adding the Vizag Pendurthi and Satara projects during the quarter.

lab.quote: Our Distribution losses in Mumbai has reduced further to 4.29 percentage in the first half.

call_memory.quote: Our Distribution losses in Mumbai has reduced further to 4.29 percentage in the first half.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Mumbai distribution losses reduced to 4.29% in the first half despite consumption increasing by more than 10%.

lab.quote: Smart Metering, we have now delivered about 14.8 million meters so far. And around 60 percentage of our order book, that we have delivered and balance portion, we wish to complete in another 12 to 14-month time.

call_memory.quote: Smart Metering, we have now delivered about 14.8 million meters so far. And around 60 percentage of our order book, that we have delivered and balance portion, we wish to complete in another 12 to 14-month time.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company has delivered about 14.8 million smart meters to date, representing around 60% of its order book, and aims to complete the remainder in 12 to 14 months.

lab.quote: And we already have a tie-up of 4 gigawatt of renewables and 3.5 gigawatt of base capacity. So while we are tying up on the supply side, we have also now started tie up on the consumer side. We executed a 2,500-megawatt RE-RTC contract with MSEDCL.

call_memory.quote: And we already have a tie-up of 4 gigawatt of renewables and 3.5 gigawatt of base capacity. So while we are tying up on the supply side, we have also now started tie up on the consumer side. We executed a 2,500-megawatt RE-RTC contract with MSEDCL.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Energy Solutions platform has tied up 4 GW of renewables and 3.5 GW of base capacity on the supply side, while executing a 2,500 MW RE-RTC contract with MSEDCL.

lab.quote: And once we have the CCI approval, we will complete the transaction immediately. So we expect that will happen in next one month time.

call_memory.quote: And once we have the CCI approval, we will complete the transaction immediately. So we expect that will happen in next one month time.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Intellismart acquisition approval from CCI is pending and expected within the next month following secured utility approvals.

lab.quote: We expect to do total capex of transmission in the range of about INR14,000 crore. So we will be doing about INR8,000 crores to INR9,000 crores of capex in second half.

call_memory.quote: We expect to do total capex of transmission in the range of about INR14,000 crore. So we will be doing about INR8,000 crores to INR9,000 crores of capex in second half.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Transmission capex is targeted at about INR 14,000 crores for the full year, with INR 8,000 crores to INR 9,000 crores expected to be deployed in the second half.

lab.quote: And you must have seen that we have done this long-term PPA with MSEDCL, which will start operating from last quarter of this year.

call_memory.quote: And you must have seen that we have done this long-term PPA with MSEDCL, which will start operating from last quarter of this year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The 2,500 MW MSEDCL PPA will begin operations from the last quarter of the current fiscal year.

lab.quote: So we will continue to scale up this volume, and we will reach to about total aggregate capacity on both sides about 7,000 megawatts to 8,000 megawatts of tie up over 3 to 4 years.

call_memory.quote: So we will continue to scale up this volume, and we will reach to about total aggregate capacity on both sides about 7,000 megawatts to 8,000 megawatts of tie up over 3 to 4 years.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The Energy Solutions platform targets scaling aggregate tied-up capacity across supply and consumer sides to 7,000 MW to 8,000 MW over the next 3 to 4 years.

lab.quote: Halvad is stacked up because of the ROW problem. And we expect resolution very soon. In fact, it is being discussed at Government of Gujarat as well as our Government of India level very frequently.

call_memory.quote: Halvad is stacked up because of the ROW problem. And we expect resolution very soon. In fact, it is being discussed at Government of Gujarat as well as our Government of India level very frequently.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Transmission commissioning of Halvad is held up due to right-of-way (ROW) challenges, which are being addressed with the Government of Gujarat and Government of India.

lab.quote: See, there are two companies, MEGPTCL and ATIL, where we have decided to go to the new tax regime and recognize the past paid MAT assets in the books of account which are close to around INR1,500 crores. Since these are Section 62 assets, and therefore corresponding adjustable recoverable liability has also been created and to that extent, there is no impact on P&L.

call_memory.quote: See, there are two companies, MEGPTCL and ATIL, where we have decided to go to the new tax regime and recognize the past paid MAT assets in the books of account which are close to around INR1,500 crores. Since these are Section 62 assets, and therefore corresponding adjustable recoverable liability has also been created and to that extent, there is no impact on P&L.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company transitioned MEGPTCL and ATIL to the new tax regime, recognizing MAT credit assets of around INR 1,500 crores with a corresponding adjustable recoverable liability created under Section 62, resulting in zero P&L impact.

lab.quote: See, the average realization as far as trading is concerned is about INR5.75. And what we sell on exchange on behalf of others, we get about INR0.02 to INR0.03 per unit.

call_memory.quote: See, the average realization as far as trading is concerned is about INR5.75. And what we sell on exchange on behalf of others, we get about INR0.02 to INR0.03 per unit.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Average realization in trading is about INR 5.75 per unit, while sales executed on power exchanges on behalf of others earn a fee of about INR 0.02 to INR 0.03 per unit.

lab.quote: So we plan for about 80 to 90 lakh meters this year. And the balance about 40 lakh, 45 lakh, we hope that we will be able to complete in the next half year.

call_memory.quote: So we plan for about 80 to 90 lakh meters this year. And the balance about 40 lakh, 45 lakh, we hope that we will be able to complete in the next half year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Smart meter installation target for the current fiscal year is planned at 80 to 90 lakh meters, with the remaining 40 to 45 lakh meters targeted for the next half year.

lab.quote: In terms of time lines and the capacity, 2.5 gigawatts MSEDCL signed, the capacity starts being deployed from end of February this year, 1,000 megawatts, then 1,000 megawatts from end of April and then another 500 megawatts end of July in the next year.

call_memory.period: by end of February this year
call_memory.quote: In terms of time lines and the capacity, 2.5 gigawatts MSEDCL signed, the capacity starts being deployed from end of February this year, 1,000 megawatts, then 1,000 megawatts from end of April and then another 500 megawatts end of July in the next year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The 2.5 GW MSEDCL PPA capacity will deploy 1,000 MW by end-February, 1,000 MW by end-April, and 500 MW by end-July of the next fiscal year.

lab.quote: And right now, see, I think the tender pipeline itself at the country level is around INR140,000 crores.

call_memory.quote: And right now, see, I think the tender pipeline itself at the country level is around INR140,000 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Total power transmission tender pipeline across central and state authorities in India stands at around INR 140,000 crores.

lab.quote: See, as we said in the earlier question, we actually expect to incur to INR6,000 crores additional capex in the second half of this year and another INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores in the FY '28.

call_memory.quote: See, as we said in the earlier question, we actually expect to incur to INR6,000 crores additional capex in the second half of this year and another INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores in the FY '28.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Transmission segment capex is projected at an additional INR 6,000 crores in H2 FY27 and INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores in FY28.

lab.quote: So the capitalization also would be of the order of INR8,000 crores to INR9,000 crore.

call_memory.quote: So the capitalization also would be of the order of INR8,000 crores to INR9,000 crore.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Transmission asset capitalization is expected to be around INR 8,000 crores to INR 9,000 crores in FY27 and around INR 10,000 crores in FY28.

call_points.text: Energy Solutions platform delivered over ₹2,000 Cr revenue and over ₹800 Cr EBITDA in Q2FY27.
Executed a 2,500-megawatt RE-RTC contract with MSEDCL, scaling up customer-side tie-ups.
H1FY27 capex deployment reached an all-time high of ₹7,850 Cr across all businesses.
Smart metering installations reached 14.8 million meters, achieving about 60% of the total order book.
Roughly 75% to 80% of the overall debt portfolio is on a fixed coupon basis.

guidance.statement: FY27 capex will be around ₹21,000 to ₹22,000 Cr.
Expects ₹20,000-25,000 Cr of transmission capex addition every year at about 25% market share
Expects about ₹1 lakh Cr of transmission bidding opportunity a year combining central and state projects
Targets 7.5 GW of Energy Solutions market opportunity by 2031

operating_notes.text: Mumbai HVDC project fully commissioned in March 2026, contributing a full-year tariff of ₹1,300 Cr in FY27.
Energy Solutions has tied up about 5,000 MW of green supply, of which roughly 4,000 MW is from AVL and the rest from third parties, plus 3,500 MWh of battery storage on take-or-pay contracts.
Smart meter installations reached 1.34 Cr against an order book of 2.46 Cr; with IntelliSmart the combined portfolio would be about 4.7 Cr meters.
Long-term PPA sales realised ₹1,838 Cr on 3,325 MUs in Q1FY27, with bilateral contract tenures of 1 to 13 months and prices ranging from ₹3 to ₹13-15 per unit.
Energy Solutions platform delivered over ₹2,000 Cr revenue and over ₹800 Cr EBITDA in Q2FY27, with a 2,500 MW RE-RTC contract executed with MSEDCL.

timeline.summary: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd scheduled a Q4FY26 results conference call with CEO Kandarp Patel, CFO Kunjal Mehta, and Head Finance Prashant Soni on April 24, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,443.27 Cr (+16.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹683.78 Cr.
Adani Energy Solutions submitted the audio recording link for its Q4FY26 results investor call held on April 24, 2026.
ICRA assigned AA+ (Stable) to Adani Energy Solutions' proposed limits and reaffirmed A1+ commercial paper on April 27, 2026.
Adani Energy Solutions held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding FY27 capex to ₹21,000-22,000 Cr and highlighting the commissioning of the Mumbai HVDC project.
S.B. Adani Family Trust (via **Pritamkumar Pritamkumar Nenmal Shah**) declared no new encumbrances on Adani Energy Solutions shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Adani Energy Solutions submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY25-26.
Adani Energy Solutions incorporated seven wholly owned subsidiaries on June 1, 2026.
On its 22 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, AESL said its new Energy Solutions vertical earned ₹570 Cr EBIT on ₹1,838 Cr of long-term PPA sales (3,325 MUs), with only 400-500 MUs on signed C&I contracts.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹10,075.54 Cr (+52.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,322.85 Cr (+147.7% YoY).
Adani Energy Solutions Limited submitted audio recording of analyst/investor call for unaudited results of quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026, effective 26 October 2026.
Adani Energy Solutions reported Q2FY27 results with total income up over 50% YoY and outlined robust scaling in its Energy Solutions platform and transmission capex.
